leadText:
Secret Quest (Korean: 비밀찾기 Bimilchatgi, transl. "Finding the Secret") is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Mega Voltage arc and the fourth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ090, replacing We Are The One. It uses the same animation as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, Ready Go.

The full version of the song was released on November 4, 2025. The ending animation video was uploaded to the Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 23, 2026.
plainText:
Secret Quest (Korean: 비밀찾기 Bimilchatgi, transl. "Finding the Secret") is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Mega Voltage arc and the fourth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ090, replacing We Are The One. It uses the same animation as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, Ready Go.

The full version of the song was released on November 4, 2025. The ending animation video was uploaded to the Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 23, 2026.

==Ending animation==
===Synopsis===
The starting animation beings with it being nighttime and Liko's Meowscarada and are sleeping together on her bed while Liko is at her desk doing something before she stretches and falls asleep as the next to her shimmers and glows before the scene changes to that of a forest where Liko is seen with Pagogo on her head, Meowscarada on her right, and Hattrem on her left as she is collecting sticks. The next scene is Dot with a fishing rod and leaning back in shock at a roaring at her as it breaches the surface of the lake while cheers on her left and moves to catch her. Next, Ult is seen with his arms raised and looking mad with looking on. It then turns to Roy who is holding onto 's talons with Captain Pikachu on top of it, running beside Roy, and on Roy's back, smiling together. 

The next scene includes Mollie and Orla sitting down at a table with , , and at their side while adds her cream to a cake that Murdock is holding while watches. Liko, who is holding a laughing Terapagos, and Dot, who has her hands frantically in her hair, are trying to stop , who has an Ancient Poké Ball in her mouth, and , the latter two Pokémon having Lucius's belt as Tinkatink waves her hammer. Ludlow and are at another table having treats in the shape of . Down the line, Roy has on his head while and Cap are enjoying the sweets as Friede and are seen together watching them all with their backs to the camera.

The final scene switches to the Brave Olivine where Ult and Sableye are sitting at the front before the scene moves to the right showing and floating above with the behind them. The camera pans down diagonally, showing hovering above Crocalor on the railing beside Roy, Lucario, and Kilowattrel on the deck beside them. Cap is yelling at Pagogo who is chasing as Hattrem is between the two Pokémon. Tinkatuff is near Dot who has her Nidothing suit in her hands with Quaxwell at her right side. Beside them are , , and the three as the camera stops on Liko and Meowscarada smiling together. The scene transitions into a drawing on Liko's Rotom Pad when it zooms out, revealing Liko sleeping on her desk.

aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Secret Quest
Category:Korean ending themes
Secret Quest (Korean: 비밀찾기 Bimilchatgi, transl. "Finding the Secret") is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Mega Voltage arc and the fourth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ090, replacing We Are The One. It uses the same animation as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, Ready Go.

The full version of the song was released on November 4, 2025. The ending animation video was uploaded to the Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on January 23, 2026.
